svg.title: Devices node wiring
svg.desc: ESP32 DevKit top view. Five LEDs, each from a GPIO (23, 22, 21, 19, 18) through a 220 ohm resistor to the LED's long leg; all short legs join a GND rail wired to GND. A passive buzzer module: VCC to 3V3, I/O to GPIO 25, GND to GND. Powered by USB.
svg.text: Living room. Five LEDs stand for the lights of five rooms; the passive buzzer module sounds every alarm.
USB power: phone charger, power bank or the computer
Light · Living room · untick “on with LOW”
Light · Master bedroom · untick “on with LOW”
Alarm buzzer · passive, on with LOW
Long leg (+, anode) to the resistor,
short leg (−, flat side) to the GND rail.
220 Ω gives about 6 mA: bright, safe.
Red, yellow or green LEDs work best at
3.3 V; white or blue ones glow dimmer
(use 100 Ω for those if you have it).
VCC to 3V3, GND to GND, I/O to D25.
It sounds when I/O is LOW (低电平触发),
so keep “Switches on with LOW” ticked.
